title: The convergence-divergence criterion for the Mañé cohomology lemma and Livšic theorem
summary: We establish a new dynamical convergence-divergence criterion for the existence of Lipschitz functions with continuous sub-actions, over general dynamical systems. This unifies and generalises various versions of the Mañé cohomology lemma, in the setting of uniformly expanding maps, and systems with indifferent fixed points.
